subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_bias_reference_generator vdd iref_snk
M1 iref_snk iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_bias_reference_generator
subcircuits.role_hint: Bias generation network using diode-connected PMOS M1. The external sink current at iref_snk establishes an AC-stiff PMOS gate bias voltage that biases the PMOS current-source devices in the amplifier and driver stages.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt error_amplifier_differential_input_stage vdd gnd iref_snk vin fb net7
M4 net7 vin net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M3 net6 fb net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M2 net5 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
M8 net6 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M7 net7 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
.ends error_amplifier_differential_input_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: Core error-amplifier differential input stage. PMOS pair M4/M3 compares reference/input vin against feedback fb, M2 provides the PMOS tail/source bias from iref_snk, and NMOS mirror load M8/M7 converts the differential signal into the single-ended internal output net7.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_gate_driver_gain_stage vdd gnd iref_snk net7 net2
M6 gnd net7 net2 vdd pmos l=l_eab_p w=w_eab_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M5 net2 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_gate_driver_gain_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: Second gain and PMOS pass-device gate-driver stage. M5 acts as a PMOS current-source pull-up biased by iref_snk, while M6 is controlled by the error-amplifier output net7 to drive the pass-transistor gate node net2.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_pass_output_stage_with_feedback_divider vdd gnd net2 vo fb
M0 vo net2 vdd vdd pmos l=l_power_p w=w_power_p*1 m=1 nf=1
R1 vo fb res r1
R2 fb gnd res r2
.ends pmos_pass_output_stage_with_feedback_divider
subcircuits.role_hint: LDO PMOS power output stage and resistive feedback network. M0 is the PMOS pass transistor driven at net2, producing regulated output vo. R1/R2 sense vo and generate the feedback voltage fb for the error amplifier.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt miller_compensation_rc_network net7 vo
R0 net1 vo res r0
C0 net7 net1 cap c0
.ends miller_compensation_rc_network
subcircuits.role_hint: Series RC Miller/feed-forward compensation network connected between the internal amplifier node net7 and the regulated output vo. It shapes loop stability without carrying DC current between stages.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt output_load_capacitor vo GND
CL vo GND cap cload
.ends output_load_capacitor
subcircuits.role_hint: Output load capacitor connected from the regulated output vo to ground, representing the LDO output capacitance/load pole.
